An '''antiques dealer''' was a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who specialized in the buying and selling of antiques. [[Grathal]] was an antiques dealer operating on [[Hargeeva]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
